description: This file contains JUnit test cases for the AuthorRepository, which tests basic CRUD operations such as find all, delete, and delete all for the Author entity within a Spring Data JPA context.

classes.name: AuthorRepositoryTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the AuthorRepository repository in a Spring Data JPA context, including methods to verify retrieval and deletion functionalities.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment by deleting all entries in the AuthorRepository before each test.

methods.name: canFindAll
methods.description: Tests whether the repository can correctly retrieve all stored Author entities.

methods.name: canDeleteIfExists
methods.description: Tests whether an Author entity can be deleted if it exists in the repository.

methods.name: canDeleteAll
methods.description: Tests whether all Author entities can be deleted from the repository.
